en.t: The method of drawing rhyme words:

units.source_text: 于庭中设一文台，台上罗列许多韵字纸，背面向上。

en.t: A writing table is set up in the garden, and many slips of paper bearing rhyme words are laid out on it, face down.

units.source_text: 作诗者各自探取一纸，以此纸上所书字为韵而作诗。

en.t: Each person composing a poem draws one slip, then writes a poem using the character written on that slip as the rhyme word.
All of the poems composed are Chinese-style poems.
